summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 17% YoY to INR116 crore, but EBITDA margin fell to 27% on high employee and other costs against uneven quarterly revenue.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was INR116 crore (+17% YoY) with gross margin of 78.9%, while EBITDA was INR31.4 crore (27% margin) and PAT INR22.1 crore (19% margin). Management attributed the margin dip to higher employee costs from capability expansion, a product mix shift, additional repairs and maintenance during facility revamping, and about INR2 crore of provisions against long-standing receivables. Management said some customer inspection and approval delays shifted revenue out of the quarter. Order book was INR920 crore at 30 June 2026, rising to INR2,654 crore including orders received in July and orders negotiated (not yet converted).

EBITDA margin 27%; no YoY figure stated

financial_highlights.value: Up ~64% YoY (as per analyst question, not disputed)
financial_highlights.change: Driven by R&M for revamp and ~INR2 crore receivable provision

segments.name: Defense electronics (avionics, radars, EW, automotive test equipment)
segments.commentary: Orders secured from MoD, DRDO and BrahMos across avionics, radars, electronic warfare and automotive test equipment; no segment-wise revenue split was given on the call.

segments.name: Drone and counter-drone
segments.commentary: Initial order traction began in the quarter; management expects several hundred crore of contracts during FY27, not included in the INR2,000 crore inflow target.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: International order book INR39 crore; first antenna redesign order for a fighter aircraft subsystem under delivery in 6-8 months; UK airborne radar signal processor work ongoing.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance: revenue growth of 20% to 25% and EBITDA margin of 35% to 40%; management said the full-year budget is on track despite Q1 margins.
Expects about INR2,000 crore of fresh order inflows in FY27 over and above orders received and negotiated.
Negotiated orders of about INR1,726 crore (not yet in order book) expected to convert in the next few months, with some contracts about 2 months away.
Expects BrahMos seeker commercial order within FY27 (order intake, not revenue).
Capex of INR150-200 crore minimum over the next 2 years for buildings, clean rooms, integration facility, production lines and IT/AI infrastructure; management said it could exceed this.
Employee costs expected to stay elevated over coming quarters.
capex_capacity: Capex of INR150-200 crore minimum over next 2 years; foundation work for new building started and infrastructure equipment ordered.
Plans include a building in car parks, clean rooms, an integration facility and production lines plus test equipment for large contracts.
Significant IT and server investment for AI-driven initiatives.
Facility under revamping in the quarter, which added R&M costs.
Jammer pod for Su-30: qualification expected before December, then flight trials and commercial production.
demand_pricing: Negotiated orders of INR1,726 crore excluding HAL; delays due to customer approval and program stretch (>1.5 years), with additional time granted by a customer.

Management pursuing about INR20 billion of single-vendor order prospects in FY27, including a potential HAL order (~INR10 billion per prior quarter) and BrahMos seekers; not in the INR2,654 crore order book.
Addressable market cited at INR40,000-50,000 crore, of which about INR30,000 crore is new and INR10,000-12,000 crore repeat contracts (air defense radars, EW, counter-drone).
Listed a Su-30 EW suite opportunity of about 270 aircraft, a potential INR7,000 crore contract, expected in about 2 years.
Export group being set up; US/European OEM interest in obsolescence and upgrade work; multi-million-dollar opportunity expected in the next few months.
Management said inspection delays by customers will recur because revenue depends on customer-linked milestones; order book is to grow to at least 3 years of revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Why did other expenses rise 64% against 17% revenue growth?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said higher R&M from facility revamp and about INR2 crore additional provision against long-standing receivables drove the increase; otherwise in line with budget.

qa_highlights.question: Quantum of revenue slipped due to customer approval delays?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to quantify, citing customer confidentiality; said inspection delays are recurring and quarterly revenue is uneven as this is a yearly business.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline for the negotiated orders to convert into order book?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said some contracts should convert within about 2 months; a customer granted a 2-month extension, and protracted negotiations on other orders are concluding.

qa_highlights.question: Why are margins lower this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said gross margin was higher YoY; the EBITDA margin fell because fixed overheads (other expenses, depreciation) were spread over lower quarterly revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline for the Su-30 jammer pod?
qa_highlights.answer: Qualification expected before December, followed by a few months of flight trials; commercial production after that. Contract expected in about 2 years; value not disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Status of the BrahMos seeker orders and HimShakti?
qa_highlights.answer: BrahMos seeker commercial order expected in FY27 after qualification. HimShakti: original products delivered; BEL discussing a new programme but no RFP confirmed.

qa_highlights.question: Acquisition of ST Advanced and its rationale?
qa_highlights.answer: Management described it as a small composites company to support radome and composite requirements for sensors; strategy still being developed, deal finalised the previous day.

qa_highlights.question: Capex plan for the next two years?
qa_highlights.answer: INR150-200 crore minimum, potentially more, for buildings, clean rooms, integration facility, production lines and IT/AI infrastructure.

risks_watch: Quarter-to-quarter revenue volatility from customer inspection and approval delays; margins swing with revenue timing.
Conversion of INR1,726 crore negotiated orders and the approximately INR20 billion FY27 prospects; repeated slippage of large orders (HAL, BrahMos seekers) has occurred.
Elevated employee costs and capex ramp (INR150-200 crore+) could keep EBITDA margins below the 35-40% guidance band in near term.
Receivable quality: INR2 crore provided for long-standing receivables this quarter.
Su-30 jammer pod and HAWK radar timelines depend on qualification, flight trials and Russian OEM collaboration with no firm dates.
ST Advanced acquisition: strategy not yet defined; subsidiary is small and loss-making per management's description of SMEs.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on long-term opportunities and addressable market, but evasive on specifics (order mix, revenue slippage quantum, product values, timelines), repeatedly deferring to future announcements. Margin explanation was defensive, stressing gross margin and yearly budget.
key_quotes: Increase in other expenses is due to some additional repairs and maintenance costs, which is incurred because the facility is going through some revamping.
And also close to INR2 crores, we have additionally provided for against the long-standing receivables as per our policy.
We are a yearly business and all the projects are long term.
I expect this to happen before end of this year. It is one of the projections which we have for this year revenue in terms of order intake.
Revenue in one quarter is 1/4, then the margin will be changed. Since the revenue is not equally distributed across the quarters, you're finding the so-called EBITDA margins coming down.
We remain confident of achieving our full year guidance, growth guidance of 20% to 25% revenue growth while maintaining EBITDA margins in the 35% to 40% range.
